product.name: MALM
product.introText: MALM chest of 3 drawers 80x48x78 cm, white. Assembly instructions AA-2022888-8 (frame) and AA-1971377-2 (drawers). Two people; work on a soft surface. Tools: Phillips and flat screwdrivers, hammer, drill for the wall fixing. The chest must be fixed to the wall - it can tip over.
product.partsSummary: 2x Back,  1x Bottom panel,  2x Bracket,  8x Bscrew,  14x Cam,  14x Cam bolt,  6x Connector,  1x D1 back,  1x D1 bar,  2x D1 bar screw,  1x D1 bottom,  2x D1 bscrew,  4x D1 cam,  4x D1 cam bolt,  4x D1 dowel,  1x D1 front,  4x D1 long screw,  6x D1 rscrew,  1x D1 runner a,  1x D1 runner b,  1x D1 side a,  1x D1 side b,  1x D2 back,  1x D2 bar,  2x D2 bar screw,  1x D2 bottom,  2x D2 bscrew,  4x D2 cam,  4x D2 cam bolt,  4x D2 dowel,  1x D2 front,  4x D2 long screw,  6x D2 rscrew,  1x D2 runner a,  1x D2 runner b,  1x D2 side a,  1x D2 side b,  1x D3 back,  1x D3 bar,  2x D3 bar screw,  1x D3 bottom,  2x D3 bscrew,  4x D3 cam,  4x D3 cam bolt,  4x D3 dowel,  1x D3 front,  4x D3 long screw,  6x D3 rscrew,  1x D3 runner a,  1x D3 runner b,  1x D3 side a,  1x D3 side b,  18x Dowel,  1x Mid panel,  30x Nail,  1x Plinth,  3x Rail,  2x Side,  1x Top,  2x Wall bracket,  2x Wall long screw,  2x Wall plug,  2x Wall screw,  4x Wall washer

steps.title: Cam bolts into the sides
steps.text: Lay both sides on a soft surface, runners up. Screw 10 cam bolts (118331) into the sides, 5 per side.

steps.title: Connectors and angle brackets
steps.text: Push 4 connectors (153548) into the front ends of the sides. Screw the 2 angle brackets (10038685) onto the plinth with 4 screws (155669) and push 2 connectors into the plinth ends.

steps.title: Plinth onto the first side
steps.text: Fit the plinth onto one side and screw its angle bracket to the side with 1 screw (155669) - the bracket must sit flush with the edge (see the inset).

steps.title: Fit the 3 rails
steps.text: Push 6 dowels (101345) into the ends of the 3 rails, stand the rails in the side and lock each one with a cam (117434).

steps.title: Middle panel
steps.text: Push 4 dowels (101345) into the middle panel, raw face as shown in the inset, fit it into the side and lock it with 1 cam.

steps.title: Bottom panel
steps.text: Do the same with the bottom panel: 4 dowels, fit it into the side, lock it with 1 cam.

steps.title: Second side on top
steps.text: Put the second side on top, onto all dowels and cam bolts.

steps.title: Lock the second side
steps.text: Screw the angle bracket to the second side with 1 screw (155669) and lock the rails and panels with 5 cams.

steps.title: Prepare the top
steps.text: Screw 4 cam bolts (118331) into the underside of the top. Screw the 2 wall brackets (106989) to the back of the top with the screws (109049) and washers (100823).

steps.title: Stand it up and fit the top
steps.text: Stand the chest upright. Push 4 dowels (101345) into the top edges of the sides and put the top on - its overhang to the front (see the inset).

steps.title: Lock the top
steps.text: Lock the top with 4 cams (117434) from the inside.

steps.title: Back panel - first nail
steps.text: Lay the chest on its front. Put both halves of the back onto the back edges and fix the first corner with 1 nail (101221).

steps.title: Square the back
steps.text: Push the chest square so the back lines up with all edges, then nail the other corners (2 nails).

steps.title: Nail the back
steps.text: Nail the back with 27 more nails along the sides and into the two panels.

steps.title: Stand it up against the wall
steps.text: Stand the chest upright against the wall. Fix it to the wall with the wall plugs (121714), screws (109048) and washers (100823) through the wall brackets - pages 25-31 show the right fixing for your wall type.

steps.title: Drawers: cam bolts into the fronts
steps.text: Do the drawer steps for each of the 3 drawers. Lay the drawer front face down and screw in 4 cam bolts (118331).

steps.title: Drawers: dowels and sides
steps.text: Push 4 dowels (101345) into the front and fit the two drawer sides onto them and the cam bolts.

steps.title: Drawers: lock the sides
steps.text: Lock both sides with 4 cams (117434), turning them clockwise.

steps.title: Drawers: slide in the bottom
steps.text: Slide the drawer bottom into the grooves of the sides and the front, smooth side up.

steps.title: Drawers: fit the back
steps.text: Fit the drawer back between the sides (check the notch in the inset), screw it on through the sides with 4 screws (110519) and through the bottom with 2 screws (115339).

steps.title: Drawers: runners
steps.text: Turn the drawer over and screw the 2 runners (118790 / 148601) onto the sides with 6 screws (100365) - the wheel goes to the back.

steps.title: Drawers: stabiliser bar
steps.text: Clip the stabiliser bar (123833) onto the back of the drawer and fix its ends with 2 screws (105344).

steps.title: Put in the drawers
steps.text: Put each drawer on the runners of its compartment and push it in until it closes. Open only one drawer at a time.

steps.title: Done
steps.text: Check that the chest is fixed to the wall. Open only one drawer at a time.
